activities.title: Nets and Shape Models

The box returns to its earlier shape. Nets at the end of the book help us make models. The craft section groups the shapes under prisms and pyramids. We can make a sphere-like shape with paper strips.

Models also include a square pyramid and a hexagonal prism.
